Kinetic Headline
01 / 10TYPE / IMPACT

Kinetic Headline

Words that make an entrance.

THE PROMPT

Create a 1:1 kinetic typography motion for [BRAND]. Use two strong headline words, one entering from the left and one from the right. Add a thin brand-color underline. Editorial layout, high contrast, no photography. CSS-only, seamless 3-second loop.

Orbiting Identity
02 / 10IDENTITY / ORBIT

Orbiting Identity

Make your identity feel alive.

THE PROMPT

Design an editorial orbiting logo animation for [BRAND], with a large central circular badge and three smaller orbiting elements. Use brand colors, clean geometry, minimal text, no stock images. Build it in HTML/CSS with a 3-second repeating orbit.

Editorial Card Stack
03 / 10LAYERS / DEPTH

Editorial Card Stack

A little depth, a lot of character.

THE PROMPT

Animate a stack of three editorial cards for [BRAND] that alternate front-to-back in a 3-second loop. Each card should have a unique title and one brand color. Add subtle shadows, large typography, CSS-only transforms and a refined SaaS look.

Rolling Words
04 / 10TYPE / SWAP

Rolling Words

One line, endless possibilities.

THE PROMPT

Build a bold editorial typography animation for [BRAND]: fixed words “MAKE IT” followed by a masked vertical word swap cycling between three benefits. Each word must occupy one line. High contrast and butter-yellow accent, 3-second seamless CSS-only loop.

Morphing Brand Shape
05 / 10SHAPES / MORPH

Morphing Brand Shape

A living shape for your brand.

THE PROMPT

Create a minimalist 3-second CSS morphing shape animation for [BRAND]. A colorful organic blob should change border-radius and rotate smoothly behind an editorial headline. Keep all text readable and the background simple. No imagery, pure HTML/CSS.

Editorial Panel Wipe
06 / 10LAYOUT / REVEAL

Editorial Panel Wipe

Reveal a new side of the story.

THE PROMPT

Create a luxury editorial wipe transition for a square motion graphic: three alternating solid-color panels slide across the canvas to reveal a high-contrast headline. Add fine rules, one serif subtitle, and a 3-second CSS loop with clean exits.

Infinite Marquee
07 / 10TYPE / MARQUEE

Infinite Marquee

Keep the message moving.

THE PROMPT

Make a bold square kinetic poster for [BRAND] with two edge-to-edge infinite marquee ribbons moving in opposite directions. The central statement stays fixed. Use flat colors and strong typography, 3-second seamless CSS loops with duplicated text for continuous scrolling.

Type-On Cursor
08 / 10DIGITAL / TYPING

Type-On Cursor

Create anticipation, letter by letter.

THE PROMPT

Create a crisp minimal type-on headline animation in HTML/CSS for [BRAND] with one line revealed through a steps() animation, a blinking block cursor and a 3-second loop. Pair it with tiny editorial system metadata and a contrasting yellow progress line. No JavaScript required.

Swinging Poster
09 / 10POSTER / SWING

Swinging Poster

Make a graphic feel tangible.

THE PROMPT

Make an editorial poster hanging from a small pin, swinging left and right in a 3-second pendulum loop. Use a strong black headline, pale-blue paper, small typographic details and a butter-yellow sticker. Render entirely with HTML/CSS, no raster assets.

Pulsing CTA
10 / 10INTERACTION / CTA

Pulsing CTA

A subtle nudge to take action.

THE PROMPT

Create a high-contrast call-to-action motion: a centered black pill button with white text, a butter-yellow circular arrow and three expanding thin rings. All motion repeats every 3 seconds using pure CSS. Make the composition mobile-first and easy to adapt for a brand.
